name: acord-data-standards-compliance
title: ACORD data standards — message, form, data-dictionary and API conformance
description: Treats ACORD (the insurance data-standards body) as a set of conformance gates: ACORD P&C / Life & Annuity / Reinsurance message schemas, standard ACORD forms, data-dictionary/code-list alignment, and ADAPT/API conformance — each decomposed into individually testable controls.
